info.title: Apiosk API
info.description: Buy verifiable data per call with an organisation API key. Discover sources, run one directly, or let Apiosk plan across sources. Amounts are USD; every amount carries an exact micro-USD integer.

apiKey.description: An organisation API key: Authorization: Bearer apk_org_live_…

get.description: Free directory of verified sources, including discovery-only and restricted entries. Requires sources:read.

capabilities.description: Advertised and accepted capabilities; check executable_capabilities to identify runnable ones.

endpoint_count.description: Registered endpoints, including endpoints without an accepted execution contract.

available_in_v2.description: True if at least one operation in the source group can run.

readiness.description: Contract and evidence coverage, not a guarantee of live provider success.

catalog_total.description: All verified directory groups, including discovery-only and restricted sources.

400.description: invalid_query in a Gateway v2 error envelope

401.description: invalid_api_key for a presented key; missing credentials can return the Gateway v2 errors array.

get.description: Free. Currently executable operations, schemas and buyer prices. Discovery-only sources can return source_not_found. Requires sources:read.

sources.description: Member service slugs for a grouped provider.

post.description: Buy one call. The body is the operation's inputs. Requires sources:execute. Also available at /v2/execute/{source}/{operation}.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Capability, endpoint id or operation name.

parameters.name: max_spend
parameters.description: Refuse before paying if the maximum cost is higher.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key: the same key with the same body pays once.

schema.description: Input values, keyed by fact type, the source's own parameter name, or an unambiguous last word.

answer.description: Apiosk's reading of the results, with evidence pointers. Null for a direct call.

data.description: The source document, when the run produced exactly one.

metadata.description: Attribution for a single result, when present.
